name: codemap
description: Opinionated Codebase Memory, rg, and ast-grep source inspection CLI.

scripts.build: pnpm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && chmod +x dist/codemap/cli.js
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && biome check src test/*.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json && pnpm run test
scripts.format: biome format src test/*.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json
scripts.format:write: biome format --write src test/*.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json
scripts.lint: biome lint src test/*.ts package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json
